question: What effects extend to the lineage and associates of such a knower?
premises: All born in his lineage are meritorious.
His friends and relatives are purified.
The sanctity of the knower extends to those connected with him.
inference: The spiritual excellence of the knower sanctifies both his descendants and his associates.
plain_english: All those born in his lineage are meritorious, and his friends and relatives are purified.
